# The composer (⌘⇧E): a prompt written there goes to the pane as one paste,
# then Return (⌘Return); put away with Esc, it keeps its draft; ⌘⇧Return
# queues it and stays open; several lines into a program that didn't ask for
# bracketed paste asks first. The pane runs a stand-in agent
# (tests/fixtures/fake-agent-queue.c, built as "claude" by tests/run.sh), which
# reads a line at a time.
type:@DIR@/claude
key:enter
wait:1.0
key:cmd+shift+e
expect-composer:open
type:hello
key:cmd+enter
wait:2.0
expect:GOT[hello]
expect-composer:closed
# A draft stays when it's put away.
key:cmd+shift+e
type:draft
key:escape
expect-composer:closed
expect-composer:text=draft
key:cmd+shift+e
expect-composer:text=draft
# Queued: it stays open for the next; the agent at rest takes it.
key:cmd+shift+enter
expect-composer:open
expect-composer:text=
wait:2.5
expect:GOT[draft]
# ⌘⇧E again puts it away.
key:cmd+shift+e
expect-composer:closed
# The prompt queue (⌘⇧M): the same composer, ⌘Return queuing.
key:cmd+shift+m
expect-composer:open
type:queued one
key:cmd+enter
expect-composer:open
wait:2.5
expect:GOT[queued one]
# Several lines, and sh's read didn't ask for bracketed paste: a queued one
# can't go as one paste, so the queue stops for you…
type:one
key:enter
type:two
key:cmd+enter
wait:1.5
expect-queue:paused
expect-queue:1
expect-queue:tag=paused
expect-not:GOT[one]
click:Remove from Queue
expect-queue:0
expect-queue:untagged
# …and sending it asks first.
key:cmd+shift+e
type:one
key:enter
type:two
key:cmd+enter
expect-sheet:yes
sheet:Cancel
expect-sheet:no
expect-composer:text=one\ntwo
# Popped out into a window of its own, and back.
composer:pop-out
expect-composer:popped
composer:pop-in
expect-composer:open
key:escape
expect-composer:closed
